"""Static coupling model for ummanu (research card ummanu-220).

Read-only. Reads Git objects of --repo, parses Python with ast; never imports or
executes analyzed code. Helpers (snapshot, changed_paths, module_name, documentation,
select) come from that repository's scripts/ci_selection.py, loaded by path.

The model scans every file at *symbol* level (top-level def/class/assignment/import
binding) and then collapses symbols back to module nodes for every module that is not
in the scenario's "split" set. With split=empty and opacity="selector" it reproduces
ci_selection.select (checked: PR717 -> identical 291 module set). Splitting a module
models a refactor where each top-level symbol lives in its own module (upper bound of
what a split of that module can achieve). Splitting a package __init__ models removing
its re-export barrel. Opacity tiers model selector-only fixes.

Usage (parse cache defaults to $TMPDIR/ummanu-220-scan-cache.pickle; cold parse ~10 s/tree):
  python3 -I coupling.py --repo REPO pr717                  -> pr717.json   (decomposition of 291/294)
  python3 -I coupling.py --repo REPO graph --sha b612ad3a   -> graph.json   (hubs, SCCs, sizes, layers)
  python3 -I coupling.py --repo REPO history -n 20          -> history.json (scenarios x last 20 code PRs)
  python3 -I coupling.py --repo REPO reach --sha b612ad3a   -> reach.json   (churn-weighted change reach)
Needs durations.json (python3 -I durations.py) for job-second figures.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import collections
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import pickle
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

OPAQUE_CALLS = {"exec", "eval", "spec_from_file_location", "run_module", "run_path",
                "read_text", "read_bytes", "open", "getsource", "source_trees",
                "Popen", "run", "call", "check_output", "check_call", "system", "entry_points"}
LOADERS = {"exec", "eval", "spec_from_file_location", "run_module", "run_path", "getsource",
           "source_trees", "entry_points"}
PROCESS = {"run", "Popen", "call", "check_output", "check_call", "system"}
TARGET = re.compile(r"(?:ummanu|tests)(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+")
TOP = "__top__"
SCAN_VERSION = 2
try:
    DURATIONS = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "durations.json").read_text())["modules"]
except OSError:
    DURATIONS = {}


def load_selector(repo: Path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_ci_selection", repo / "scripts/ci_selection.py")
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


def manifest(sel, repo: Path, sha: str) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    text = sel.git_bytes(repo, "show", f"{sha}:tests/ci-shards.txt").decode()
    grouped = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
            suite, path = line.split()
            grouped[suite].append(path)
    return dict(grouped)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- file scan
def _bindings(stmt):
    """Names a top-level statement binds (descending into if/try/with blocks)."""
    if isinstance(stmt, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
        return [stmt.name]
    if isinstance(stmt, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
        return [(a.asname or a.name.split(".")[0]) for a in stmt.names if a.name != "*"]
    if isinstance(stmt, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign)):
        targets = stmt.targets if isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign) else [stmt.target]
        return [n.id for t in targets for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.Name)]
    return []


def scan(name: str, path: str, text: str):
    """Return per-symbol facts for one file. Symbol TOP holds non-binding top-level code."""
    tree = ast.parse(text, filename=path)
    package = name if path.endswith("/__init__.py") else name.rpartition(".")[0]
    all_nodes = tuple(ast.walk(tree))
    docstrings = {id(i.body[0].value) for i in all_nodes
                  if isinstance(i, (ast.Module, ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
                  and i.body and isinstance(i.body[0], ast.Expr)
                  and isinstance(i.body[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(i.body[0].value.value, str)}
    aliases_last = {a.asname or a.name: a.name.rpartition(".")[2]
                    for i in all_nodes if isinstance(i, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) for a in i.names}

    def resolve(node):
        prefix = node.module or ""
        if node.level:
            comps = package.split(".")
            prefix = ".".join(comps[:len(comps) - node.level + 1] + ([prefix] if prefix else []))
        return prefix

    # flatten top-level statements (if/try blocks are transparent)
    flat = []

    def flatten(body):
        for s in body:
            if isinstance(s, (ast.If, ast.Try)) and not _bindings(s):
                inner = s.body + s.orelse + (s.finalbody if isinstance(s, ast.Try) else []) + \
                    [x for h in getattr(s, "handlers", []) for x in h.body]
                if any(_bindings(x) or isinstance(x, (ast.If, ast.Try)) for x in inner):
                    flatten(inner)
                    test = getattr(s, "test", None)
                    if test is not None:
                        flat.append((TOP, test))
                    continue
            flat.append((None, s))
    flatten(tree.body)

    symbols = {}          # sym -> dict(refs=set(names), attrs=set((alias, attr)), targets=[(module, kind)], opaque=set, dump=str)
    imports = {}          # binding name -> (module, attr|None)   (top-level only)
    order = []

    def sym(key):
        if key not in symbols:
            symbols[key] = {"refs": set(), "bare": set(), "attrs": set(), "targets": [], "opaque": set(),
                            "dump": [], "kind": None}
            order.append(key)
        return symbols[key]

    for forced, stmt in flat:
        names = [] if forced else _bindings(stmt)
        if isinstance(stmt, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
            for a in stmt.names:
                if isinstance(stmt, ast.Import):
                    bound = a.asname or a.name.split(".")[0]
                    imports[bound] = (a.name if a.asname else a.name.split(".")[0], None)
                    s = sym(bound)
                    s["targets"].append((a.name, "import"))
                    s["dump"].append(ast.dump(stmt))
                else:
                    prefix = resolve(stmt)
                    if a.name == "*":
                        s = sym(TOP)
                        s["opaque"].add("star-import")
                        s["targets"].append((prefix, "import"))
                        continue
                    bound = a.asname or a.name
                    imports[bound] = (prefix, a.name)
                    s = sym(bound)
                    s["targets"].append((f"{prefix}.{a.name}", "import"))
                    s["dump"].append(ast.dump(stmt))
            continue
        keys = names or [TOP]
        for key in keys:
            s = sym(key)
            s["kind"] = s["kind"] or (
                "class" if isinstance(stmt, ast.ClassDef) else
                "def" if isinstance(stmt, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) else
                "top" if key == TOP else "assign")
            if isinstance(stmt, ast.ClassDef) and any(
                    (b.id if isinstance(b, ast.Name) else getattr(b, "attr", "")).endswith(("Error", "Exception"))
                    for b in stmt.bases):
                s["kind"] = "exception"
            s["dump"].append(ast.dump(stmt))
            walked = tuple(ast.walk(stmt))
            attr_values = {id(n.value) for n in walked if isinstance(n, ast.Attribute)}
            for node in walked:
                _scan_node(node, s, docstrings, aliases_last, resolve, attr_values)
    for key, s in symbols.items():
        s["dump"] = hashlib.sha1("\n".join(s["dump"]).encode()).hexdigest()
    return {"package": package, "symbols": symbols, "imports": imports}


def _scan_node(node, s, docstrings, aliases_last, resolve, attr_values):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        s["refs"].add(node.id)
        if id(node) not in attr_values:
            s["bare"].add(node.id)
    elif isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name):
        s["attrs"].add((node.value.id, node.attr))
    elif isinstance(node, ast.Import):
        for a in node.names:
            s["targets"].append((a.name, "lazy"))
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
        prefix = resolve(node)
        for a in node.names:
            if a.name == "*":
                s["opaque"].add("star-import")
                s["targets"].append((prefix, "lazy"))
            else:
                s["targets"].append((f"{prefix}.{a.name}", "lazy"))
    elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str) and id(node) not in docstrings:
        for t in TARGET.findall(node.value):
            s["targets"].append((t, "string"))
    elif isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        f = node.func
        raw = f.id if isinstance(f, ast.Name) else (f.attr if isinstance(f, ast.Attribute) else "")
        called = aliases_last.get(raw, raw)
        if called in {"import_module", "__import__"}:
            if node.args and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.args[0].value, str):
                s["targets"].append((node.args[0].value, "dynamic"))
            else:
                s["opaque"].add("dynamic-import")
        if called in OPAQUE_CALLS:
            recv = ""
            if isinstance(f, ast.Attribute):
                v = f.value
                recv = v.id if isinstance(v, ast.Name) else (v.attr if isinstance(v, ast.Attribute)
                                                             else type(v).__name__)
            s["opaque"].add(f"{recv}.{raw}" if recv else raw)
        # python-subprocess marker for the heuristic tier
        for arg in ast.walk(node):
            if isinstance(arg, ast.Attribute) and arg.attr == "executable" and \
                    isinstance(arg.value, ast.Name) and arg.value.id == "sys":
                s["opaque"].add("~sys.executable")


class Snapshot:
    def __init__(self, sel, sources: dict[str, str], cache: dict):
        self.sel = sel
        self.files = {}
        self.lines = {}
        for path, text in sources.items():
            name = sel.module_name(path)
            key = (SCAN_VERSION, name, path, hashlib.sha1(text.encode()).hexdigest())
            if key not in cache:
                cache[key] = scan(name, path, text)
            self.files[name] = cache[key]
            self.lines[name] = text.count("\n") + 1
        self.modules = set(self.files)
        self.nodes_mod = set(self.modules)
        for n in self.modules:
            parts = n.split(".")
            for i in range(1, len(parts)):
                self.nodes_mod.add(".".join(parts[:i]))

    def opaque_modules(self):
        return {m: set().union(*(s["opaque"] for s in f["symbols"].values()))
                for m, f in self.files.items()
                if any(s["opaque"] for s in f["symbols"].values())}


# ------------------------------------------------------------ opacity tiers
def tier_selector(m, triggers):
    return bool(triggers - {"~sys.executable"})


def tier_qualified(m, triggers):
    """Only qualified loader/source/process APIs (subprocess.*, os.system, exec/eval,
    loaders, getsource, entry_points, star/dynamic imports). Drops name-only matches:
    mock call, asyncio.run, self.run, path.read_text/open of data files."""
    for t in triggers:
        recv, _, fn = t.rpartition(".")
        if fn in LOADERS or t in {"star-import", "dynamic-import"}:
            return True
        if recv in {"subprocess", "os"} and fn in PROCESS:
            return True
    return False


def tier_python_process(m, triggers):
    """Heuristic (not a proof): a subprocess is treated as possibly running repository
    Python only when the same unit mentions sys.executable. git/docker/tmux calls drop."""
    for t in triggers:
        recv, _, fn = t.rpartition(".")
        if fn in LOADERS or t in {"star-import", "dynamic-import"}:
            return True
    return "~sys.executable" in triggers and tier_qualified(m, triggers)


def tier_none(m, triggers):
    return False


TIERS = {"selector": tier_selector, "qualified": tier_qualified,
         "python-process": tier_python_process, "none": tier_none}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ graph
# Minimal layering slice M: move TaskError/cleanup locks/watchdog status out of the god
# modules into kernel modules, config stops importing domain validators, barrels stop
# re-exporting. Modeled as dropping these consumer-prefix -> dependency-prefix edges.
LAYER_CUTS = [("ummanu.board", "ummanu.tasks"), ("ummanu.config", "ummanu.tasks"),
              ("ummanu.config", "ummanu.sprints"), ("ummanu.config", "ummanu.runtime.heads"),
              ("ummanu.config", "ummanu.po"), ("ummanu.config", "ummanu.onboarding"),
              ("ummanu.config", "ummanu.head_registry"), ("ummanu.tasks", "ummanu.dispatch.cleanup"),
              ("ummanu.sprints", "ummanu.dispatch.cleanup"), ("ummanu.board", "ummanu.dispatch.cleanup"),
              ("ummanu.webproto", "ummanu.dispatch.watchdog"), ("ummanu.tasks", "ummanu.secret_store"),
              ("ummanu.tasks", "ummanu.dispatch.types")]


def apply_cuts(graph, cuts, barrels=()):
    def mod(n):
        return n.split("::")[0]
    out = {}
    for c, ds in graph.items():
        if mod(c) in barrels and "::" not in c:
            out[c] = {d for d in ds if not d.startswith(c + ".")}
            continue
        out[c] = {d for d in ds if not any((mod(c) == a or mod(c).startswith(a + ".")) and
                                           (mod(d) == b or mod(d).startswith(b + ".")) for a, b in cuts)}
    return out


def build_graph(snap: Snapshot, split: set[str], tier, edge_kinds=None, carve=None, cuts=None):
    """Consumer -> dependencies over nodes. Node = module, or 'module::symbol' for split
    modules; a split module's bare node 'module' depends on all its symbols."""
    files = snap.files

    carve = carve or {}

    def node(mod, symbol=None):
        if symbol is not None and (mod in split or symbol in carve.get(mod, ())):
            return f"{mod}::{symbol}"
        return mod

    def target_nodes(target):
        """Nodes reached by importing/naming the dotted target (with ancestor packages)."""
        parts = target.split(".")
        out = set()
        for n in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
            anc = ".".join(parts[:n])
            if anc not in snap.nodes_mod:
                continue
            last = n == len(parts)
            if anc in split:
                if last:
                    out.add(anc)          # whole module (bare reference)
                else:
                    # attribute of the module (next part) or package execution
                    nxt = parts[n]
                    sub = f"{anc}.{nxt}"
                    if sub in snap.nodes_mod:
                        out.add(node(anc, TOP))   # executing package __init__ top only
                    elif anc in files and nxt in files[anc]["symbols"]:
                        out.add(node(anc, nxt))
                    else:
                        out.add(node(anc, TOP))
            elif not last and parts[n] in carve.get(anc, ()):
                out.add(node(anc, parts[n]))   # moved to a leaf module: owner not executed
                break
            else:
                out.add(anc)
        return out

    def package_nodes(pkg):
        parts = pkg.split(".")
        out = set()
        for n in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
            anc = ".".join(parts[:n])
            if anc in snap.nodes_mod:
                out.add(node(anc, TOP) if anc in split else anc)
        return out

    graph = collections.defaultdict(set)
    opaque_nodes = {}
    for mod, f in files.items():
        syms = f["symbols"]
        imports = f["imports"]
        for key, s in syms.items():
            me = node(mod, key)
            deps = graph[me]
            for t, kind in s["targets"]:
                if edge_kinds is not None and kind not in edge_kinds:
                    continue
                if kind == "import" and t in split and key in imports and imports[key][1] is None \
                        or kind == "import" and t in split and key in imports and f"{imports[key][0]}.{imports[key][1]}" == t:
                    # module alias of a split module: precise use comes from attrs/bare refs
                    deps |= package_nodes(t)
                    continue
                deps |= target_nodes(t)
            for ref in s["refs"]:
                if ref in syms and ref != key:
                    deps.add(node(mod, ref))
            for ref in s["bare"]:
                if ref in imports:
                    tmod, tattr = imports[ref]
                    full = f"{tmod}.{tattr}" if tattr else tmod
                    if full in split:
                        deps.add(full)
            for alias, attr in s["attrs"]:
                if alias in imports:
                    tmod, tattr = imports[alias]
                    full = f"{tmod}.{tattr}" if tattr else tmod
                    deps |= target_nodes(f"{full}.{attr}")
            if mod in split:
                deps.add(node(mod, TOP))
                if key != TOP:
                    graph[mod].add(me)
            if s["opaque"]:
                opaque_nodes.setdefault(me, set()).update(s["opaque"])
            # every module executes its package __init__ chain
            pkg = mod.rpartition(".")[0] if f["package"] == mod else f["package"]
            if pkg:
                deps |= package_nodes(pkg)
        if mod in split:
            graph[mod].add(node(mod, TOP))
    # bare split-module node depends on all of its symbols already; ensure presence
    for n in snap.nodes_mod:
        graph.setdefault(n, set())
    # opacity: universal dependencies
    everything = set(graph)
    product = {n for n in everything if n == "ummanu" or n.startswith("ummanu.")}
    opaque = {n for n, t in opaque_nodes.items() if tier(n, t)}
    # a split opaque symbol only taints itself; a module-level opaque node taints the module
    for n in opaque:
        graph[n] |= (everything if n.startswith("tests.") else product) - {n}
    for n in graph:
        graph[n].discard(n)
    if cuts:
        graph = apply_cuts(graph, cuts, BARRELS)
    return graph, opaque


def closure(graph, changed):
    rev = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for c, deps in graph.items():
        for d in deps:
            rev[d].add(c)
    seen, stack = set(changed), list(changed)
    while stack:
        for c in rev.get(stack.pop(), ()):
            if c not in seen:
                seen.add(c)
                stack.append(c)
    return seen


def changed_nodes(old: Snapshot | None, new: Snapshot, paths, split, sel, carve=None):
    """Changed modules, refined to changed symbols for split modules."""
    out = set()
    carve = carve or {}
    for p in paths:
        m = sel.module_name(p)
        if m is None:
            continue
        if m in carve and m not in split and old and m in old.files and m in new.files:
            sa, sb = old.files[m]["symbols"], new.files[m]["symbols"]
            for k in sa.keys() | sb.keys():
                if k not in sa or k not in sb or sa[k]["dump"] != sb[k]["dump"]:
                    out.add(f"{m}::{k}" if k in carve[m] else m)
            continue
        if m not in split:
            out.add(m)
            continue
        a = old.files.get(m) if old else None
        b = new.files.get(m)
        if a is None or b is None:
            out.add(m)
            continue
        sa, sb = a["symbols"], b["symbols"]
        for k in sa.keys() | sb.keys():
            if k not in sa or k not in sb or sa[k]["dump"] != sb[k]["dump"]:
                out.add(f"{m}::{k}")
    return out


def union(g1, g2):
    return {n: g1.get(n, set()) | g2.get(n, set()) for n in g1.keys() | g2.keys()}


def selected_tests(grouped, sel, affected):
    owners = {p: s for s, ps in grouped.items() for p in ps}
    hit = sorted(p for p in owners if sel.module_name(p) in affected)
    return hit, sorted({owners[p] for p in hit})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scenarios
BARRELS = {"ummanu.board", "ummanu.runtime.head", "ummanu.webproto", "ummanu.web",
           "ummanu.webfront", "ummanu.runtime.head.local_pty"}


def god_modules(snap, k=12):
    prod = [m for m in snap.modules if m.startswith("ummanu.")]
    return set(sorted(prod, key=lambda m: -snap.lines[m])[:k])


def test_support(snap):
    return {m for m in snap.modules if m.startswith("tests.") and not m.split(".")[-1].startswith("test_")}


def compute_carve(snap, min_owner_closure=20, small_closure=5):
    """Seam K: leaf symbols (errors, constants, pure helpers) that other modules import
    from a heavy module. A symbol is carvable when its symbol-level dependencies reach no
    other product module except tiny leaf modules. Moving it to a leaf module unhooks its
    importers from the owner. Returns {owner: {symbol}} for externally used symbols."""
    prod = {m for m in snap.modules if m.startswith("ummanu")}
    mod_graph, _ = build_graph(snap, set(), tier_none)
    closure_size = {m: len({n for n in closure_forward(mod_graph, m) if n in prod}) for m in prod}
    small = {m for m in prod if closure_size[m] <= small_closure}
    g, _ = build_graph(snap, prod, tier_none)
    rev = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for c, ds in g.items():
        for d in ds:
            rev[d].add(c)
    carve = {}
    for m in prod:
        if closure_size[m] < min_owner_closure:
            continue
        for k, info in snap.files[m]["symbols"].items():
            if k == TOP or info["kind"] is None:
                continue
            me = f"{m}::{k}"
            if not any(c.split("::")[0] != m for c in rev.get(me, ())):
                continue
            reach = {n.split("::")[0] for n in closure_forward(g, me)}
            other = {r for r in reach if r in prod and r != m and r not in small
                     and not (r in snap.modules and snap.files[r]["package"] == r)}
            if not other:
                carve.setdefault(m, set()).add(k)
    return carve


def scenarios(snap):
    """(name, split set, opacity tier, policy, carve). Policy 'selector' = today's fallbacks;
    'manifest' = a tests/ci-shards.txt diff selects only the modules whose entry changed,
    and a changed opaque *test* module no longer forces the full run (its consumers are
    still found by the closure)."""
    gods = god_modules(snap)
    support = test_support(snap)
    allprod = {m for m in snap.modules if m.startswith("ummanu")}
    carve = compute_carve(snap)
    return [
        ("S0 selector today", set(), "selector", "selector", None, None),
        ("M@S0 layering slice, selector unchanged", set(), "selector", "selector", None, LAYER_CUTS),
        ("R2@S0 refactor K+R1+R2, selector unchanged", BARRELS | gods, "selector", "selector", carve, None),
        ("P1 manifest-aware policy", set(), "selector", "manifest", None, None),
        ("P2 P1 + qualified opacity", set(), "qualified", "manifest", None, None),
        ("M P2 + layering slice", set(), "qualified", "manifest", None, LAYER_CUTS),
        ("K P2 + leaf errors/helpers carved", set(), "qualified", "manifest", carve, None),
        ("R1 K + de-barrel packages", BARRELS, "qualified", "manifest", carve, None),
        ("R2 R1 + split 12 god modules", BARRELS | gods, "qualified", "manifest", carve, None),
        ("R3 R2 + split test support", BARRELS | gods | support, "qualified", "manifest", carve, None),
        ("R4 R3 + subprocess tests declared", BARRELS | gods | support, "python-process", "manifest", carve, None),
        ("C0 code only: P1, no opacity, no split", set(), "none", "manifest", None, None),
        ("U1 floor: P1, every module split, no opacity", allprod | support, "none", "manifest", None, None),
    ]


def evaluate(sel, grouped, old, new, changes, split, tier_name, policy="selector", old_grouped=None, carve=None, cuts=None):
    """Mirror select(): fallbacks first, then closure over base|candidate graphs."""
    paths = {p for _, items in changes for p in items}
    code = {p for p in paths if not sel.documentation(p)}
    total = sum(len(v) for v in grouped.values())
    full = lambda reason, **kw: {"mode": "full", "reason": reason, "modules": total,
                                 "owners": len(grouped), **kw}
    extra = set()
    if policy == "manifest" and "tests/ci-shards.txt" in code:
        code.discard("tests/ci-shards.txt")
        before = {(s, p) for s, ps in (old_grouped or {}).items() for p in ps}
        after = {(s, p) for s, ps in grouped.items() for p in ps}
        extra = {sel.module_name(p) for _, p in before ^ after}
    if not code and not extra:
        return {"mode": "docs-only", "modules": 0, "owners": 0}
    if any(sel.module_name(p) is None for p in code):
        return full("non-Python/shared path", paths=sorted(p for p in code if sel.module_name(p) is None)[:6])
    if any(st[0] in "DRT" for st, items in changes if any(p in code for p in items)):
        return full("delete/rename")
    tier = TIERS[tier_name]
    g_old, op_old = build_graph(old, split, tier, carve=carve, cuts=cuts)
    g_new, op_new = build_graph(new, split, tier, carve=carve, cuts=cuts)
    changed = changed_nodes(old, new, code, split, sel, carve) | extra
    blocking = changed & (op_old | op_new)
    if policy == "manifest":
        blocking = {n for n in blocking if not n.startswith("tests.")}
    if blocking:
        return full("changed opaque code", nodes=sorted(blocking)[:6])
    affected = closure(union(g_old, g_new), changed)
    hit, owners = selected_tests(grouped, sel, affected)
    if not hit:
        return full("no consumer")
    return {"mode": "affected", "modules": len(hit), "owners": len(owners), "selected": hit}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ commands
def load_cache(path):
    try:
        return pickle.loads(path.read_bytes())
    except (OSError, pickle.UnpicklingError, EOFError):
        return {}


def code_prs(sel, repo, n):
    out = sel.git_bytes(repo, "log", "--merges", "--first-parent", "main", "--format=%H %s",
                        f"-{4 * n}").decode()
    prs = []
    for line in out.splitlines():
        sha, subj = line.split(" ", 1)
        m = re.search(r"#(\d+)", subj)
        p1, p2 = sel.git_bytes(repo, "rev-parse", f"{sha}^1", f"{sha}^2").decode().split()
        mb = sel.git_bytes(repo, "merge-base", p1, p2).decode().strip()
        changes = sel.changed_paths(sel.git_bytes(repo, "diff", "--name-status", "-z", "--find-renames",
                                                  mb, p2, "--"))
        paths = {p for _, ps in changes for p in ps}
        if all(sel.documentation(p) for p in paths):
            continue
        numstat = sel.git_bytes(repo, "diff", "--shortstat", mb, p2).decode().strip()
        prs.append({"pr": int(m.group(1)) if m else None, "branch": subj.rpartition(" ")[2],
                    "merge": sha, "base": mb, "head": p2, "changes": changes,
                    "paths": sorted(paths), "shortstat": numstat})
        if len(prs) == n:
            break
    return prs


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    ap.add_argument("--cache", type=Path, default=None)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("pr717")
    g = sub.add_parser("graph")
    g.add_argument("--sha", default="HEAD")
    rc = sub.add_parser("reach")
    rc.add_argument("--sha", default="HEAD")
    rc.add_argument("--since", default="2026-07-11")
    h = sub.add_parser("history")
    h.add_argument("-n", type=int, default=20)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    sel = load_selector(args.repo)
    import tempfile
    cache_path = args.cache or Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "ummanu-220-scan-cache.pickle"
    cache = load_cache(cache_path)
    try:
        if args.cmd == "pr717":
            cmd_pr717(sel, args, cache)
        elif args.cmd == "graph":
            cmd_graph(sel, args, cache)
        elif args.cmd == "reach":
            cmd_reach(sel, args, cache)
        else:
            cmd_history(sel, args, cache)
    finally:
        cache_path.write_bytes(pickle.dumps(cache))


def cmd_pr717(sel, args, cache):
    repo = args.repo
    base, head = "8d722448497dcbd4ab32ee6e347fb1bc53024d9d", "ac037ac7927cc2937f098431fee145ba7cad99be"
    grouped = manifest(sel, repo, head)
    old_src, new_src = sel.snapshot(repo, base), sel.snapshot(repo, head)
    changes = sel.changed_paths(sel.git_bytes(repo, "diff", "--name-status", "-z", base, head, "--"))
    _, _, selected, explanations = sel.select(grouped, changes, old_src, new_src)
    real = sorted(p for ps in selected.values() for p in ps)
    old, new = Snapshot(sel, old_src, cache), Snapshot(sel, new_src, cache)
    result = {"base": base, "head": head, "selector_plan_modules": len(real),
              "selector_reasons": dict(collections.Counter(
                  "changed test" if v == ["changed test"] else
                  "conservative opaque consumer" if v == ["conservative opaque consumer"] else
                  "import consumer" for v in explanations.values())),
              "scenarios": {}}
    code = [p for _, ps in changes for p in ps]
    for name, split, tier, policy, carve, cuts in scenarios(new):
        r = evaluate(sel, grouped, old, new, changes, split, tier, policy, grouped, carve, cuts)
        chosen = r.pop("selected", None) or [p for ps in grouped.values() for p in ps]
        r["job_seconds"] = round(sum(DURATIONS.get(p, 0.0) for p in chosen))
        result["scenarios"][name] = r
    # reproduction check
    g, _ = build_graph(new, set(), tier_selector)
    g = union(build_graph(old, set(), tier_selector)[0], g)
    hit, _ = selected_tests(grouped, sel, closure(g, {sel.module_name(p) for p in code}))
    result["model_reproduces_selector_exactly"] = hit == real
    # decomposition of the 291: opaque tests vs reached through import chain
    tier = tier_selector
    g_none = union(build_graph(old, set(), tier_none)[0], build_graph(new, set(), tier_none)[0])
    via_imports = set(selected_tests(grouped, sel, closure(g_none, {sel.module_name(p) for p in code}))[0])
    op_tests = {p for p in real if sel.module_name(p) in new.opaque_modules() and tier(None, new.opaque_modules()[sel.module_name(p)])}
    result["decomposition"] = {
        "selected": len(real),
        "reached_by_pure_imports": len(via_imports),
        "opaque_tests_selected": len(op_tests),
        "opaque_and_import_reached": len(op_tests & via_imports),
        "only_because_test_is_opaque": len(op_tests - via_imports),
        "only_via_opaque_product_module": len(set(real) - via_imports - op_tests),
        "not_selected": sorted(set(p for ps in grouped.values() for p in ps) - set(real)),
    }
    # first hops of the pure-import chains
    rev = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for c, ds in g_none.items():
        for d in ds:
            rev[d].add(c)
    start = {sel.module_name(p) for p in code}
    parent = {n: None for n in start}
    queue = collections.deque(start)
    while queue:
        x = queue.popleft()
        for c in sorted(rev[x]):
            if c not in parent:
                parent[c] = x
                queue.append(c)
    chains = collections.Counter()
    for p in via_imports:
        n, chain = sel.module_name(p), []
        while n:
            chain.append(n)
            n = parent[n]
        chain = chain[::-1][1:-1]
        chains[" > ".join(chain[:3]) or "(direct)"] += 1
    result["shortest_import_chains_top"] = chains.most_common(20)
    # what one cut would do (pure imports)
    cuts = []
    affected = closure(g_none, start)
    for h in sorted(n for n in affected if n.startswith("ummanu") and n not in start):
        g2 = {c: ds - {h} for c, ds in g_none.items() if c != h}
        cuts.append((len(selected_tests(grouped, sel, closure(g2, start))[0]), h))
    result["best_single_node_cuts_pure_imports"] = sorted(cuts)[:10]
    (args.out / "pr717.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "shortest_import_chains_top"}, indent=1)[:4000])


def tarjan(graph):
    sys.setrecursionlimit(100000)
    index, low, stack, on, out, i = {}, {}, [], set(), [], [0]

    def visit(v):
        index[v] = low[v] = i[0]
        i[0] += 1
        stack.append(v)
        on.add(v)
        for w in graph.get(v, ()):
            if w not in index:
                visit(w)
                low[v] = min(low[v], low[w])
            elif w in on:
                low[v] = min(low[v], index[w])
        if low[v] == index[v]:
            comp = []
            while True:
                w = stack.pop()
                on.discard(w)
                comp.append(w)
                if w == v:
                    break
            out.append(comp)
    for v in list(graph):
        if v not in index:
            visit(v)
    return out


def structure_scenarios(snap, prod):
    """SCC sizes and import closures (top-level + lazy + strings/attrs, module level)."""
    out = {}
    prod = set(prod)
    tests = [m for m in snap.modules if m.startswith("tests.test_")]
    for name, cuts, split in [("current", None, set()), ("layering slice M", LAYER_CUTS, set()),
                              ("every module split (floor)", None, prod)]:
        g, _ = build_graph(snap, split, tier_none, cuts=cuts)
        mods = lambda nodes: {n.split("::")[0] for n in nodes} & prod
        g_mod = collections.defaultdict(set)
        for c, ds in g.items():
            g_mod[c.split("::")[0]] |= {d.split("::")[0] for d in ds}
        sccs = sorted((len(c) for c in tarjan({k: {d for d in v if d in prod and d != k}
                                                for k, v in g_mod.items() if k in prod})), reverse=True)
        sizes = sorted(len(mods(closure_forward(g, t))) for t in tests)
        out[name] = {
            "largest_sccs": sccs[:3],
            "closure_board.models": len(mods(closure_forward(g, "ummanu.board.models"))),
            "closure_config": len(mods(closure_forward(g, "ummanu.config"))),
            "closure_tasks": len(mods(closure_forward(g, "ummanu.tasks"))),
            "test_closure_median": sizes[len(sizes) // 2],
            "tests_over_200": sum(s > 200 for s in sizes),
        }
    return out


def cmd_graph(sel, args, cache):
    repo = args.repo
    sha = sel.git_bytes(repo, "rev-parse", args.sha).decode().strip()
    snap = Snapshot(sel, sel.snapshot(repo, sha), cache)
    grouped = manifest(sel, repo, sha)
    prod = sorted(m for m in snap.modules if m.startswith("ummanu"))

    def module_graph(kinds):
        g, _ = build_graph(snap, set(), tier_none, kinds)
        return {c: {d for d in ds if d.startswith("ummanu")} for c, ds in g.items() if c.startswith("ummanu")}
    top = module_graph({"import"})
    full = module_graph(None)
    # direct (non-ancestor) top-level import edges for fan-in/out
    direct = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for m in prod:
        for key, s in snap.files[m]["symbols"].items():
            for t, kind in s["targets"]:
                if kind in {"import", "lazy"}:
                    parts = t.split(".")
                    for n in range(len(parts), 0, -1):
                        cand = ".".join(parts[:n])
                        if cand in snap.modules and cand != m:
                            direct[m].add(cand)
                            break
    fan_in = collections.Counter(d for m in prod for d in direct[m])
    tests_in = collections.Counter()
    test_closure = {}
    g_none, _ = build_graph(snap, set(), tier_none)
    for suite, paths in grouped.items():
        for p in paths:
            test_closure[p] = {n for n in closure_forward(g_none, sel.module_name(p)) if n.startswith("ummanu.")}
            for n in test_closure[p]:
                tests_in[n] += 1
    # reverse reach of each product module (how many tests a change would select, pure imports)
    reach = {}
    for m in prod:
        affected = closure(g_none, {m})
        reach[m] = len(selected_tests(grouped, sel, affected)[0])
    sccs_top = sorted((sorted(c) for c in tarjan(top) if len(c) > 1), key=len, reverse=True)
    sccs_full = sorted((sorted(c) for c in tarjan(module_graph({"import", "lazy"})) if len(c) > 1),
                       key=len, reverse=True)
    sccs_all = sorted((sorted(c) for c in tarjan(full) if len(c) > 1), key=len, reverse=True)
    layer = lambda m: m.split(".")[1] if m.count(".") >= 1 else m
    layer_edges = collections.Counter()
    for m in prod:
        for d in direct[m]:
            a, b = layer(m), layer(d)
            if a != b and m.count(".") >= 2 and d.count(".") >= 2:
                layer_edges[(a, b)] += 1
    bidirectional = sorted({tuple(sorted((a, b))) for (a, b) in layer_edges if (b, a) in layer_edges})
    opaque = snap.opaque_modules()
    reach_values = sorted(reach.values())
    result = {
        "sha": sha,
        "product_modules": len(prod), "product_lines": sum(snap.lines[m] for m in prod),
        "test_modules_in_manifest": sum(len(v) for v in grouped.values()),
        "largest_modules": sorted(((snap.lines[m], m) for m in prod), reverse=True)[:15],
        "fan_in_top": fan_in.most_common(20),
        "fan_out_top": sorted(((len(direct[m]), m) for m in prod), reverse=True)[:20],
        "product_modules_in_test_import_closures_top": tests_in.most_common(20),
        "test_import_closure_size": {
            "median_product_modules": sorted(len(v) for v in test_closure.values())[len(test_closure) // 2],
            "over_200_product_modules": sum(1 for v in test_closure.values() if len(v) > 200),
        },
        "change_reach_pure_imports": {
            "median_tests": reach_values[len(reach_values) // 2],
            "modules_reaching_over_250_tests": sum(1 for v in reach_values if v > 250),
            "modules_reaching_under_50_tests": sum(1 for v in reach_values if v < 50),
            "histogram_by_50": dict(collections.Counter(min(v // 50 * 50, 250) for v in reach_values)),
        },
        "scc_top_level_imports": [len(c) for c in sccs_top],
        "scc_with_lazy_imports": [len(c) for c in sccs_full],
        "scc_selector_edges(lazy+strings+package)": [len(c) for c in sccs_all][:5],
        "largest_scc_with_lazy": sccs_full[0] if sccs_full else [],
        "layer_edges_bidirectional": [(a, b, layer_edges[(a, b)], layer_edges[(b, a)]) for a, b in bidirectional],
        "opaque": {
            "selector": {"tests": sum(1 for m, t in opaque.items() if m.startswith("tests.test_") and tier_selector(m, t)),
                         "product": sum(1 for m, t in opaque.items() if m.startswith("ummanu") and tier_selector(m, t))},
            "qualified": {"tests": sum(1 for m, t in opaque.items() if m.startswith("tests.test_") and tier_qualified(m, t)),
                          "product": sum(1 for m, t in opaque.items() if m.startswith("ummanu") and tier_qualified(m, t))},
            "python-process": {"tests": sum(1 for m, t in opaque.items() if m.startswith("tests.test_") and tier_python_process(m, t)),
                               "product": sum(1 for m, t in opaque.items() if m.startswith("ummanu") and tier_python_process(m, t))},
            "trigger_counts_selector": collections.Counter(t for ts in opaque.values() for t in ts
                                                           if not t.startswith("~")).most_common(25),
        },
        "structure_scenarios": structure_scenarios(snap, prod),
        "edges": {m: sorted(direct[m]) for m in prod},
    }
    (args.out / "graph.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in {"edges", "largest_scc_with_lazy"}}, indent=1))


def test_bits(graph, tests):
    """node -> bitmask of tests whose dependency closure contains the node."""
    index = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(tests)}
    rev = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for c, ds in graph.items():
        for d in ds:
            rev[d].add(c)
    nodes = set(graph) | set(rev)
    bits = {}
    for comp in tarjan({n: rev.get(n, ()) for n in nodes}):   # consumers-first order
        mask = 0
        members = set(comp)
        for n in comp:
            if n in index:
                mask |= 1 << index[n]
            for c in rev.get(n, ()):
                if c not in members:
                    mask |= bits[c]
        for n in comp:
            bits[n] = mask
    return bits


def cmd_reach(sel, args, cache):
    """Churn-weighted 'what would a change select': every product/test-support file
    weighted by the number of main commits that touched it since --since."""
    repo = args.repo
    sha = sel.git_bytes(repo, "rev-parse", args.sha).decode().strip()
    snap = Snapshot(sel, sel.snapshot(repo, sha), cache)
    grouped = manifest(sel, repo, sha)
    tests = [p for ps in grouped.values() for p in ps]
    names = [sel.module_name(p) for p in tests]
    secs = [DURATIONS.get(p, 0.0) for p in tests]
    total_secs = sum(secs)
    churn = collections.Counter(
        sel.module_name(p) for p in sel.git_bytes(repo, "log", f"--since={args.since}", "--format=",
                                                   "--name-only", sha, "--", "src/ummanu", "tests").decode().split()
        if p.endswith(".py") and sel.module_name(p) in snap.modules)
    weights = {m: w for m, w in churn.items() if not m.split(".")[-1].startswith("test_")}
    out = {"sha": sha, "since": args.since, "weighted_files": len(weights),
           "weighted_changes": sum(weights.values()), "scenarios": {}}
    for name, split, tier_name, policy, carve, cuts in scenarios(snap):
        graph, opaque = build_graph(snap, split, TIERS[tier_name], carve=carve, cuts=cuts)
        bits = test_bits(graph, names)
        full_mask = (1 << len(names)) - 1
        samples = []
        for m, w in weights.items():
            if m in split:
                keys = [f"{m}::{k}" for k in snap.files[m]["symbols"]]
            elif carve and m in carve:
                keys = [f"{m}::{k}" if k in carve[m] else m for k in snap.files[m]["symbols"]]
            else:
                keys = [m]
            keys = keys or [m]
            per = []
            for key in keys:
                blocked = key in opaque and (policy == "selector" or not key.startswith("tests."))
                mask = full_mask if blocked else bits.get(key, 0) | (bits.get(m, 0) if key == m else 0)
                per.append((bin(mask).count("1"),
                            sum(s for i, s in enumerate(secs) if mask >> i & 1)))
            samples.append((w, sum(a for a, _ in per) / len(per), sum(b for _, b in per) / len(per)))
        tot_w = sum(w for w, *_ in samples)

        def wmedian(idx):
            acc = 0
            for row in sorted(samples, key=lambda r: r[idx]):
                acc += row[0]
                if acc >= tot_w / 2:
                    return round(row[idx])
        out["scenarios"][name] = {
            "weighted_median_modules": wmedian(1),
            "weighted_mean_modules": round(sum(w * a for w, a, _ in samples) / tot_w),
            "weighted_mean_job_seconds": round(sum(w * b for w, _, b in samples) / tot_w),
            "share_of_changes_under_half_modules": round(sum(w for w, a, _ in samples if a < len(names) / 2) / tot_w, 2),
            "share_of_changes_under_half_seconds": round(sum(w for w, _, b in samples if b < total_secs / 2) / tot_w, 2),
        }
        print(name, out["scenarios"][name], flush=True)
    (args.out / "reach.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))


def closure_forward(graph, start):
    seen, stack = {start}, [start]
    while stack:
        for d in graph.get(stack.pop(), ()):
            if d not in seen:
                seen.add(d)
                stack.append(d)
    return seen


def cmd_history(sel, args, cache):
    repo = args.repo
    prs = code_prs(sel, repo, args.n)
    rows = []
    for pr in prs:
        grouped = manifest(sel, repo, pr["head"])
        old = Snapshot(sel, sel.snapshot(repo, pr["base"]), cache)
        new = Snapshot(sel, sel.snapshot(repo, pr["head"]), cache)
        row = {k: pr[k] for k in ("pr", "branch", "head", "base", "shortstat")}
        row["files"] = len(pr["paths"])
        row["total_modules"] = sum(len(v) for v in grouped.values())
        old_grouped = manifest(sel, repo, pr["base"])
        row["scenarios"] = {name: evaluate(sel, grouped, old, new, pr["changes"], split, tier, policy, old_grouped, carve, cuts)
                            for name, split, tier, policy, carve, cuts in scenarios(new)}
        row["path_map"] = path_map(pr["paths"], grouped)
        c0 = row["scenarios"]["C0 code only: P1, no opacity, no split"]
        c0_hit = set(c0.get("selected") or [p for ps in grouped.values() for p in ps])
        pm_hit = set(p for s in (row["path_map"].get("suites") or grouped) for p in grouped.get(s, []))
        row["path_map"]["misses_import_consumers"] = len(c0_hit - pm_hit)
        for r in list(row["scenarios"].values()) + [row["path_map"]]:
            chosen = r.pop("selected", None)
            if r.get("mode") == "docs-only":
                chosen = []
            elif chosen is None:
                chosen = [p for s in (r.get("suites") or grouped) for p in grouped.get(s, [])]
            r.pop("suites", None)
            per_owner = collections.Counter()
            owner_of = {p: s for s, ps in grouped.items() for p in ps}
            for p in chosen:
                per_owner[owner_of[p]] += DURATIONS.get(p, 0.0)
            r["job_seconds"] = round(sum(per_owner.values()))
            r["critical_owner_seconds"] = round(max(per_owner.values(), default=0))
        rows.append(row)
        print(pr["pr"], row["files"], " ".join(f'{k.split()[0]}={v["modules"]}{v["mode"][0]}/{v["job_seconds"]}' for k, v in row["scenarios"].items()),
              "path", row["path_map"]["modules"], row["path_map"]["job_seconds"], "miss", row["path_map"]["misses_import_consumers"],
              "crit", {k.split()[0]: v["critical_owner_seconds"] for k, v in row["scenarios"].items() if k[:2] in ("S0", "R4", "U1")}, flush=True)
    (args.out / "history.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))


# Coarse alternative (issue:7ba9a9f3): choose CI owners by a hand-written path map, no
# import analysis. A plausible map from the suite names; unknown paths -> all owners.
PATH_MAP = [
    (r"^src/ummanu/board/|^src/ummanu/(sprints|product_issues|tasks|task_commands|sprint_.*)\.py$",
     {"unit", "integration-board"}),
    (r"^src/ummanu/(restore|checkpoint|task_restore|backup_.*)\.py$|^src/ummanu/board/(postgres_recovery|normalized_checkpoint)",
     {"unit", "integration-recovery"}),
    (r"^src/ummanu/dispatch/", {"unit", "component", "integration-dispatcher"}),
    (r"^src/ummanu/runtime/|^src/ummanu/(head_.*|heads?)\.py$", {"unit", "runtime-component", "integration-heads"}),
    (r"^src/ummanu/memory|^src/ummanu/memory_", {"unit", "integration-memory"}),
    (r"^src/ummanu/(installation|upgrade|onboarding|cli)\.py$|^pyproject.toml$|^scripts/", None),
    (r"^src/ummanu/(web|webproto|webfront)/", {"unit", "component"}),
]


def path_map(paths, grouped):
    owners = set()
    for p in paths:
        if p.startswith("tests/") and p.endswith(".py"):
            for s, ps in grouped.items():
                if p in ps:
                    owners.add(s)
                    break
            else:
                return {"owners": len(grouped), "modules": sum(len(v) for v in grouped.values()), "reason": f"test support {p}"}
            continue
        if p.endswith(".md"):
            continue
        for rx, suites in PATH_MAP:
            if re.search(rx, p):
                if suites is None:
                    return {"owners": len(grouped), "modules": sum(len(v) for v in grouped.values()), "reason": p}
                owners |= suites
                break
        else:
            return {"owners": len(grouped), "modules": sum(len(v) for v in grouped.values()), "reason": f"unmapped {p}"}
    return {"owners": len(owners), "modules": sum(len(grouped.get(s, [])) for s in owners),
            "suites": sorted(owners)}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
